title: sccan
description: A tool for sparse statistical analysis on images : scca, pscca (with options), mscca. Can also convert an imagelist/mask pair to a binary matrix image.

output.description: Output dependent on which option is called.
output.title: Output

n_permutations.description: Number of permutations to use in scca.
n_permutations.title: Number of Permutations

row_sparseness.description: Row sparseness - if (+) then keep values (+) otherwise allow +/- values --- always L1.
row_sparseness.title: Row Sparseness

n_eigenvectors.description: Number of eigenvectors to compute in scca/spca.
n_eigenvectors.title: Number of Eigenvectors

covering.description: Try to make the decomposition cover the whole domain, if possible.
covering.title: Covering

l1.description: Use l1 (> 0) or l0 (< 0) penalty, also sets gradient step size.
l1.title: L1 Penalty

initialization.description: Initialization file list for Eigenanatomy - must also pass mask option.
initialization.title: Initialization

initialization2.description: Initialization file list for SCCAN-Eigenanatomy - must also pass mask option.
initialization2.title: Initialization 2

partial_scca_option.description: Choices for pscca: PQ, PminusRQ, PQminusR, PminusRQminusR.
partial_scca_option.title: Partial SCCA Option

prior_weight.description: Scalar value weight on prior between 0 (prior is weak) and 1 (prior is strong). Only engaged if initialization is used.
prior_weight.title: Prior Weight

imageset_to_matrix.description: Takes a list of image files names (one per line) and converts it to a 2D matrix/image in binary or csv format.
imageset_to_matrix.title: Imageset to Matrix

timeseriesimage_to_matrix.description: Takes a timeseries (4D) image and converts it to a 2D matrix csv format.
timeseriesimage_to_matrix.title: Timeseries Image to Matrix

vector_to_image.description: Converts the 1st column vector in a csv file back to an image.
vector_to_image.title: Vector to Image

imageset_to_projections.description: Takes a list of image and projection files names and writes them to a csv file.
imageset_to_projections.title: Imageset to Projections

scca.description: Matrix-based scca operations for 2 and 3 views.
scca.title: SCCA
